outlier_classification.classes: per_formula: a basis correction read on the page; unsigned: printed without a sign, a lost sign or a sign read on the page; unexplained: no deterministic explanation (kept as printed)
outlier_classification.criterion: value as extracted (before the page-read basis / sign corrections) differs from every matched DFT source by more than 50 kJ/mol-atom, or has the opposite sign of a source with |DFT - lit| > 10
outlier_classification.population: accepted experimental HM_FORM records matched to MP and/or OQMD, not flagged magnitude_suspect (the default subset before its point exclusions and before the unsigned / sign-lost exclusion)

description: Literature formation enthalpies (HM_FORM, kJ/mol-atom) against DFT formation energies at the same composition: the lowest entry of the space group the record names (Strukturbericht designator or prototype), else the ground state (lowest-energy entry). Materials Project and OQMD are separate sources with different energy references and are never averaged. Residual = DFT - literature.

chem_class.other_nonmetal: hydrides, borides, carbides, nitrides, phosphides, chalcogenides
chem_class.oxide_halide: oxides and halides (contains O, F, Cl, Br or I)

rules.composition_offset: dx_measured = max |x_printed - x_formula| for a printed (not formula-derived) overall composition; sigma_comp = |dx| x local hull slope (kJ/mol-atom, the Cu-Zr historical-formula rule); dx > 0.02 is not in the default subset (off_stoichiometry, or composition_conflicts_label beyond 0.1).
rules.default_subset: evidence class experimental, extraction accepted, not unsigned-in-print, no uncorrected sign loss found by the page-image sign check, not flagged magnitude_suspect by the extraction checks (a flag set before and independently of this DFT comparison); per point (`default`): not structure_unmatched, measured composition within 0.02 of the compound, not an experimental value stored at 0 K, the record's reference state is the solid standard element reference that 0 K DFT uses (no liquid / gas element reference, no reference element outside the compound; reference_state), and the record carries no literature gate failure (gate_flagged) (`excluded_by` lists the reason; audit round 3).
rules.formula: Parsed from the record's printed phase label(s): Greek and polymorph prefixes stripped, formula groups expanded, sublattice brackets read, tokens outside the record's system dropped; several distinct formulas in one record are refused. Fallback: a phase composition derived from stoichiometry.
rules.layout: records{rid: literature fields} + points[] (one per record x DFT source, joined by rid) + papers{paper id: citation, DOI}.
rules.match: Reduced composition (mole fractions rounded to 4 decimals) matched exactly to non-deprecated DFT entries; the lowest entry of the named space group (see structure), else the lowest formation energy at that composition, is used; npoly = number of entries at that composition. Binary compounds only (snapshots hold unary/binary entries).

method_class.calorimetry: calorimetry (solution, drop, combustion, direct reaction, DSC)
method_class.emf_vapour: EMF / vapour pressure / Knudsen effusion / equilibrium

rules.quality_fixes: data/literature/QUALITY_FIXES.md: the per-formula / per-atom basis of a column is decided on the printed page only (gate R2 table_basis; the earlier rule that converted a value when the converted value agreed with DFT was withdrawn in audit round 2 because it used DFT to correct the values that calibrate DFT); unsigned magnitudes are flagged unsigned_in_print (or signed from a printed negated heading); see counts.outlier_classification for the classes of the large residuals.
rules.selection: property HM_FORM; unit kJ/mol-atom; evidence class experimental, model or unspecified. 'kJ/mol (basis unstated)' is excluded (per-atom vs per-formula cannot be settled).
rules.structure: dft_structure_match (`smatch`): exact = the record names a structure (Strukturbericht designator or 'X-type' prototype in a printed label, or in a model-phase name whose formula is the compound; A1/A2/A3 ignored) and the lowest entry of that space group is used (`ground_id` = the ground state when it differs); structure_unmatched = named structure absent from the snapshot, paired with the ground state, not in the default subset; no_structure_printed = ground state.
rules.units: DFT eV/atom x 96.485 = kJ/mol-atom; ehull = energy above ORCHID's released hull of the same snapshot (hulls/dft-<src>/, kJ/mol-atom; one source of truth for MP and OQMD); ehull_upstream = the snapshot's upstream value (MP energy_above_hull; OQMD max(stability, 0), computed upstream against a different phase set).
rules.unsigned: flags.unsigned_in_print, or a sign-check verdict no_minus_printed matched by paper (PDF hash prefix), page and |printed value|: such values are magnitudes by the paper's convention and are kept out of the default set.
